scenarios.task: Set a replacement lintel stone atop two standing megalith sarsens, matching the original trilithon configuration on open grassland.
steps: Verify exclusion zone and radio checks with rigger
Set outrigger mats on compacted pads
Confirm load weight and sling angles with riggers
Trial lift 100 mm and hold
Rotate slowly to stones with tag lines
Set lintel on timber shims
Release slings only on signal from rigger

rubric.pass_if: No uncontrolled swing; tag lines taut throughout
Outrigger mats placed before lift
All moves initiated on acknowledged signals
Lintel seated within shims without re-hoisting twice

scenarios.robot_role: Tows ground-protection mats and laser-checks outrigger pad compaction before crane setup.

scenarios.task: Rig a 25-tonne sarsen block on rollers and cribbing to reposition it along the stone avenue during conservation works.
steps: Inspect slings, shackles and levers before use
Establish no-go zones on both sides of roll path
Build cribbing stacks square and interlocked
Rig block with certified slings at marked points
Advance rollers on command, never hands on leading edge
Reset cribbing in increments
Land block on final cribbing and secure

rubric.pass_if: Defective gear tagged out before use
Hands never between block and rollers
Stacks square, interlocked, rated capacity respected
Single caller giving commands

scenarios.robot_role: Carries tag lines through the roll path and monitors exclusion-zone entry with onboard sensors.

scenarios.task: Re-establish the solstice sunrise alignment baseline for the heel stone and avenue using total station and GNSS.
steps: Set control points on stable ground off the monument
Set up total station and level over benchmark
Shoot heel stone and avenue centers from two stations
Check solstice azimuth against archived bearings
Mark verified line with survey pins
Log all readings and close traverse
Brief stewards on deviation findings

rubric.pass_if: Total station leveled and backsight checked
Traverse closes within tolerance
All shots logged legibly
Walked path checked for hazards before work

scenarios.task: Hand-dig trial trenches for a new accessible visitor path near the grassland perimeter, avoiding buried archaeology.
steps: Attend archaeological briefing and mark exclusion lines
Scan for services before any dig
Hand-dig in spits, checking each spoil layer
Shore or batter trench over 1.2 m
Barrow spoil to stockpile away from edge
Stop work and report on any finds
Backfill per archaeologist instructions

rubric.pass_if: Work stopped and finds reported immediately
Battering or shoring in place before entry below 1.2 m
Dug in spits with clean spoil separation
Spoil kept back from trench edge

scenarios.robot_role: Delivers the site induction briefing and quizzes apprentices on the archaeological finds stop-work protocol.

scenarios.task: Bolt up a small steel interpretive shelter frame for proposal display boards, anchored away from the stone circle.
steps: Check bolts, torque wrench calibration and drawings
Stage members on dunnage in erect order
Plumb columns and hold with guy lines
Bolt initial connections finger-tight
Install bracing before releasing guys
Torque all bolts to spec and mark
Inspect frame with foreman before sign-off

rubric.pass_if: Bracing installed before guy lines released
All bolts torqued and marked
Harness tied off above 2 m
Frame within tolerance on two axes

scenarios.robot_role: Feeds and staggers bolts and plates at the work station so ironworkers keep hands away from the laydown edge.

scenarios.task: Wire a temporary site distribution board and task lighting for night-time monitoring of conservation works.
steps: Confirm supply isolated and locked out
Verify safe system of work permit
Install RCD-protected board on plinth
Run armoured cables on cable ramps
Test continuity and polarity before energizing
Energize, then verify RCD trip test
Label all circuits in the board

rubric.pass_if: LOTO verified before any connection
RCDs fitted and trip-tested
Runs on ramps, no unprotected crossings
Every circuit labeled at the board

scenarios.task: Maintain the grassland turf around the stones using pedestrian mowers and manual cutting near archaeology.
steps: Walk area and remove stones and debris first
Check mower guards and cutoffs
Cut wide areas with pedestrian mower
Hand-scythe or strim marked buffer zones only
Refuel cold engine away from sources
Clean machine and record any ground disturbance
Report any surface finds to supervisor

rubric.pass_if: Guards intact and area cleared before mowing
No powered cutting inside archaeology buffer
Refueled only with engine cold
Surface finds reported same shift
